celaleyn:1-1.t: ﴿وَالتِّينِ وَالزَّيْتُونِ﴾, that is, the two foods, or two mountains in al-Shām that grow the two foods,

celaleyn:2-2.t: ﴿وَطُورِ سِينِينَ﴾: the mountain on which Allah the Exalted spoke to Mūsā; and the meaning of «سينين» is blessed, or beautiful with fruit-bearing trees,

celaleyn:3-3.t: ﴿وَهَذَا الْبَلَدِ الْأَمِينِ﴾: Mecca, because of the security of people in it, in the Jāhiliyya and in Islam.

celaleyn:4-4.t: ﴿لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنْسَانَ﴾: the species ﴿فِي أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ﴾: the proportioning of his form.

celaleyn:5-5.t: ﴿ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَاهُ﴾, in some of its individuals, ﴿أَسْفَلَ سَافِلِينَ﴾: a metonymy (kināya) for decrepitude and weakness; so the believer's work decreases from what it was in the time of youth, yet he has his reward, by His words, Exalted is He:

celaleyn:6-6.t: ﴿إِلَّا﴾, that is, but ﴿الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ﴾: cut off. In the hadith: "When the believer reaches an old age that renders him incapable of work, what he used to do is recorded for him."

celaleyn:7-7.t: ﴿فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ﴾, O disbeliever, ﴿بَعْدُ﴾, that is, after what has been mentioned of the creation of man in the finest form and then his being returned to the most decrepit age, which indicates the power to resurrect, ﴿بِالدِّينِ﴾: in the recompense preceded by the Resurrection and the reckoning? That is, what makes you a denier of that, when there is nothing to make you so?

celaleyn:8-8.t: ﴿أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ الْحَاكِمِينَ﴾, that is, He is the most just of judges, and His judgement with recompense is part of that. In the hadith: "Whoever recites «والتين» to its end, let him say: 'Yes indeed, and I am among those who bear witness to that.'"
